Overview

Humans

Humans are the most widespread people in the shattered world of Destroyed Faith. They are adaptable, resilient, and painfully easy to use. Where other Echoes fade into legend, withdraw behind old walls, or carry the burden of stranger blood, humans remain everywhere: in ruined villages, demon-held cities, broken shrines, prison caravans, and forgotten roads.

Once, they lived beneath the order of the gods, serving as priests, soldiers, builders, and keepers of daily life. Now they endure among ruins, rituals, and the weight of things that no longer answer. The cities they built have become strongholds of demons, tyrants, and false faith. Those who are not made into guards, laborers, vessels, or sacrifices learn to hide, flee, obey, or die.

Yet humanity is not easily erased. Again and again, humans gather in hidden enclaves, rebel cells, smuggler camps, and wandering caravans. They keep fires lit where they should have gone out long ago. They bury their dead, pass on forbidden names, and teach their children how to survive one more winter, one more patrol, one more night.

Many humans bear a demonic mark, burned into flesh by pact, force, punishment, or inheritance. Some marks whisper. Some wound. Some tempt. A mark may offer strength, but never freely. It is always also a claim a presence that presses closer with every moment of weakness, fear, or surrender.

Humans endure because they change. Some become willing servants of hell. Some search for lost rites, hidden truths, and fragments of dead faith. Others fight for smaller, fiercer things: family, warmth, loyalty, and the simple refusal to let the darkness take everything.

Echo Deck

Human Echo Deck

"Every human is a question the world hasn’t answered yet."
Theme: Masters of bad options, they survive by making deals, adapting fast

REFUSE TO GIVE UP

Trigger: You would be taken out of the scene (overwhelmed, restrained, or removed from the conflict).

I — ONE MORE BREATH

Skill: Leadership
You steady yourself and keep moving, one last push to stay in the scene when anyone else would fold.

II — MAKE THEM HESITATE

Skill: Intimidation
It’s hopeless—but you surge one last time and force the other side to hesitate.

III — DIRTY EXIT

Skill: Streetwise
You’ve been here too often. You slip out by exploiting patterns, people, chaos, and weaknesses.

IV — HARD TERMS

Skill: Negotiation
You force structure into chaos: conditions, leverage, and a controlled de-escalation—on your terms.

DESPERATE BARGAIN

Trigger: You have no clean options left and still need a win, right now.

I — NAME YOUR PRICE

Skill: Negotiation
You state what you’ll give and what you demand—so the bargain has teeth.

II — SWEETEN THE LIE

Skill: Deception
You wrap the deal in half-truths, plausible deniability, and a story they want to believe.

III — MAKE IT PERSONAL

Skill: Persuasion
You push the one argument that hits the heart: duty, fear, love, shame, or hope.

IV — PLAY THE ROOM

Skill: Performance
You turn the moment into a scene—timing, tone, audience—so the bargain becomes inevitable.

SCRAPRUNNER INSTINCT

Trigger: You try to solve a problem with whatever is at hand—junk, broken gear, stolen parts, improvised tools.

I — QUICK HANDS, QUICK FIX

Skill: Sleight of Hand
You patch, swap, or palm the missing piece fast enough that nobody can stop you.

II — MAKE IT MOVE

Skill: Acrobatics
You use your body as the tool—balance, timing, and momentum to turn a bad setup into a working solution.

III — DO IT QUIET

Skill: Stealth
You improvise without drawing eyes: no noise, no obvious traces, no attention.

IV — FORCE IT THROUGH

Skill: Athletics
You brute the solution into place—bend, pry, drag, wedge—until reality gives in.

HARD ROAD LESSONS

Trigger: The day turns ugly—travel, pursuit, hostile ground, scarcity, or the kind of risk you only learn by surviving it.

I — FOLLOW THE SIGNS

Skill: Tracking
You read the ground, the breaks, the rhythm—finding where they went and how close they are.

II — STAY ALIVE ANYWAY

Skill: Survival
Shelter, warmth, water, food whatever the land gives, you take, without wasting time.

III — CALM THE BEAST

Skill: Animal Handling
You steady a mount, silence an animal, or keep panic from turning into catastrophe.

IV — READ THE SKY

Skill: Weather Sense
You catch what’s coming before it hits storm, cold, heat, bad visibility and adjust in time.
